title: Nearia vibecoded minecraft/wow/diablo like web-mmorpg
author: Able_Ad5050
selftext:
Hey everyone, I want to introduce you to Nearia (playnearia.online). It's a web-based MMORPG that you can play directly in your browser without having to download a massive client.

If I had to describe the vibe, it’s basically a mix of Diablo, Minecraft, and World of Warcraft. The goal was to capture the addictive loot drops and dungeon crawling from Diablo, combine it with the resource gathering and crafting freedom of Minecraft, and wrap it all up in a WoW-style open world with quests and an active community.

I also want to be super upfront about the economy: the game is strictly 100% free-to-play. We do have play-to-earn (P2E) mechanics integrated for players who are into that, but they are entirely optional. You can play the whole game, reach max level, and grind for the best gear without ever interacting with the crypto side of things. There are no paywalls or mandatory NFT requirements.

It's just a game built for people who love the old-school MMO grind. Come check it out if it sounds like your kind of thing! 

playNearia.online

Come and try!
